```{r, func_common_site, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

# Repo-level constants. Everything dataset-specific lives in common_ar*.Rmd,
# everything shared across the regional sites lives in the reportlib package.

# The tag here must match the one .github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yml
# downloads: this builds the page's download links, that fetches the data, and
# a new data release has to be pointed at in both places. It was missed once --
# the links kept the pre-rename repo and the pre-migration tag, so every one
# 404'd while the site itself rendered clean.
release_url <- "https://github.com/AIQC-Hub/arc-report/releases/download/v0.3.0"

# Templates read `rsc_dir2` by name via knit_expand, so both names are kept.
rsc_dir <- aiqc_data_dir()
rsc_dir2 <- rsc_dir

```
